5385.title: Concurrent path ranking starves daemon timers
5385.rootCauseOneLine: Discovery is shared, but each waiting command synchronously fuzzy-ranks the full listing; consecutive promise continuations prevent heartbeat timers from running beyond the 30-second lease.
5385.proposedFix: Preserve global ranking semantics while moving discovery and ranking to interruptible or isolated execution, and coalesce superseded work. Add an end-to-end liveness regression before shipping.
5385.caveats: Two clean checkouts reproduce timer starvation over 30 seconds at the real command handler. No actual daemon WebSocket disconnect or macOS desktop UI was reproduced. No PR: full end-to-end behavior remains unverified, and bounding search or isolating ranking needs contract/product or packaging decisions beyond the simple-fix gate.
